name: Unit circle
description: Place an angle on the unit circle by dragging or tapping. A new angle every review, in radians, degrees or both, sometimes negative or past a full turn. Partial credit one step off.

fields.name: prompt
fields.default: Place the angle on the unit circle.

fields.name: wrap
fields.label: Negative and large angles
fields.description: Sometimes ask for angles below 0 or past a full turn.

fields.name: angle
fields.description: Optional fixed angle in degrees (a multiple of 15). Leave empty for a new angle every review.
